subject.title: feat(agents): inject Recently Completed Subagents into parent prompt

question: Should completed-child status be injected by default into later parent-agent prompts for 30 minutes, instead of remaining available only through completion handoff and explicit subagent inspection?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and demonstrated, but it intentionally changes the default information and guidance supplied to existing parent-agent turns in multi-agent orchestration.

options.title: Accept bounded default anchors
options.body: Merge after a current-main refresh while keeping the 30-minute window, newest-eight cap, and separate completion-result handoff.

options.title: Keep completion state out of prompts
options.body: Retain completion handoff and explicit subagent inspection as the sources of finished-child state.

options.title: Design an opt-in policy
options.body: Add a supported opt-in only if maintainers want different defaults for different orchestration workflows.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded default anchors
recommendation.body: Merge after a current-main refresh while keeping the 30-minute window, newest-eight cap, and separate completion-result handoff.

likelyOwner.reason: The outstanding question is default agent-context policy in the `src/agents/` owner boundary; available evidence is insufficient to name a person reliably.
